messages:
Maya (PM): quick planning thread: customer request to support per-tenant region pin + automatic fallback to a cost-tiered model. want rollout that avoids oscillation and keeps SLAs for fallbacks. ideas?
Ravi (Eng): propose multi-dim rollout slice: tenant-pin > region > cost-tier. start with shadowing for pinned tenants, then soft-redirect (5%) before hard cut. prevents sudden lambda of traffic.
Priya (SRE): agree on shadowing. also we need a stateful sticky key so pinned tenants always hit same model variant within their session window. avoids cache cold starts.
Zoe (Data): telemetry we need for A/B: per-tenant quality score, token-usage, latency percentiles, fallback-counts, and an aggregate consumer-impact metric. daily delta + rolling 3h window alerts.
Ken (Solutions): customers care about fallback latency SLA. suggested SLA: fallback < 200ms p95 for hosted, < 300ms for dedicated (due to network hops). we need to promise and measure.
Omar (Compliance): for private/VPC customers, require KMS proof-of-rotation before enabling tenant pin + opt-in. also add audit event for every fallback decision.
Maya (PM): what about A/B experiments? do we do control/variant split inside the pin or separate cohort?
Ravi (Eng): two options: "within-pin AB" where pinned tenant has internal AB (50/50) for quality checking, or "cohort AB" where some pinned tenants are entirely control. within-pin is safer for smaller tenants. cohort-AB needed for long-term retention signals. recommend within-pin for pilot.
Priya (SRE): operational guardrails: 1) circuit-breaker when fallback-rate > 2% AND p95 latency regression > 40% 2) auto-failover TTL: if fallback triggered more than 3x in 10m for same tenant reroute to global fallback pool.
Ravi (Eng): add a short-term cache fallback option: if fallback model overloaded, return cached best-response for identical prefix when seen in last 30m (only for idempotent requests). reduces load and improves perceived SLA.
Zoe (Data): evaluation windows: short-signal (3h rolling), mid-signal (24h), experiment stat sig threshold for AB: min n=1000 requests or 95% power for mean quality diff = 1%.
Ken (Solutions): communication plan: 48h notice for enterprise opt-ins, and a rollout-playbook PDF with escape-hatch steps for customers. include a clause about fallback cost tiering.
Maya (PM): define kill-switch and rollback criteria succinctly.
Ravi (Eng): kill-switch criteria (any of): - sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline for 30m - model-token-error-rate > 1% for 15m - fallback-rate > 5% for 30m with increasing trend. Also manual rollback by SRE/PM.
Priya (SRE): add infra thresholds: GPU OOMs or node CPU > 90% for 10m => immediate degrade to fallback pool. and KV cache thrash > 4x baseline triggers rolling throttle.
Omar (Compliance): require recording of decision reason in audit log when automated rollback happens. legal needs that for postmortem.
Maya (PM): timeline suggestion: week 0 = infra + telemetry + opt-in docs; week 1 = shadow + within-pin AB on internal tenants; week 2 = 5% soft-redirect to pinned tenants; week 3 = ramp to 25% per-region and enable customer opt-ins; roll to 100% if gates pass.
Ravi (Eng): here's a minimal flag snippet we'll use for staged behavior (draft):
```yaml
flag: tenant_pin_routing_v1
modes:
  - name: shadow
    percent: 0
    description: capture logs for pinned tenants only
  - name: soft_redirect
    percent: 5
    description: route 5% of pinned request traffic to variant, rest to primary
  - name: hard_redirect
    percent: 100
    description: pinned tenants fully routed to variant
policies:
  - name: fallback_map
    condition: error_codes in [500,502,503] or latency_p95 > threshold
    action: route -> cost_tier_fallback
  - name: sticky_session
    ttl_minutes: 60
```
Zoe (Data): will prepare the canonical prompt set for pinned tenants and baseline vectors. also will add a synthetic workload that simulates tenant burst patterns.
Ken (Solutions): add notes for customer-facing SLAs & pricing: fallback usage billed at fallback-rate price; include opt-in terms.
Priya (SRE): monitoring & alerts: create dashboards for per-tenant fallback-rate, pinned-tenant latency p50/p95, cache-hit ratio, OOM events. pager for high fallback-rate + latency regression.
Maya (PM): owners & action items: Ravi -> prod flag PR + sticky logic; Priya -> provision fallback pool + alerts + runbook; Zoe -> telemetry + eval sets; Ken -> opt-in docs + SLA text; Omar -> compliance checklist & KMS gating. deliverables due EOD 2026-03-30.
Ravi (Eng): I'll prototype sticky key hashing and sticky TTL in the router today.
Priya (SRE): fallback pool standby nodes allocated in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. will post node IDs.
Zoe (Data): synthetic workload ready, will run shadow analysis during week 1.
Omar (Compliance): KMS checklist posted. legal signoff required before any customer opt-in.
deploy-bot: Scheduling note: shadow mode can be enabled by deploy-bot on 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC for internal tenants :eyes:
Maya (PM): final call: we go ahead with shadow-first, within-pin AB, and strict infra gates. I'll assemble the rollout checklist and post to launch-room. thanks everyone :tada:
